mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ticket_order WHERE id = #{orderId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM ticket_order WHERE id = #{orderId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT item.id AS order_item_id, item.passenger_id, passenger.name AS passenger_name, item.run_id, run.run_date, train.train_no, item.from_station_id, from_station.name AS from_station_name, item.to_station_id, to_station.name AS to_station_name, TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(run.run_date, INTERVAL from_stop.departure_day_offset DAY), from_stop.departure_time) AS departure_date_time, TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(run.run_date, INTERVAL to_stop.arrival_day_offset DAY), to_stop.arrival_time) AS arrival_date_time, seat_type.code AS seat_type_code, seat_type.name AS seat_type_name, coach.coach_no, seat.seat_no, item.price, item.status FROM order_item item JOIN passenger ON passenger.id = item.passenger_id JOIN train_run run ON run.id = item.run_id JOIN train ON train.id = run.train_id JOIN station from_station ON from_station.id = item.from_station_id JOIN station to_station ON to_station.id = item.to_station_id JOIN train_stop from_stop ON from_stop.train_id = run.train_id AND from_stop.stop_seq = item.from_seq JOIN train_stop to_stop ON to_stop.train_id = run.train_id AND to_stop.stop_seq = item.to_seq JOIN seat_type ON seat_type.id = item.seat_type_id LEFT JOIN train_seat seat ON seat.id = item.seat_id LEFT JOIN train_coach coach ON coach.id = seat.coach_id WHERE item.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY departure_date_time, item.passenger_id, item.id

SELECT orders.id AS order_id, orders.order_no, orders.status AS order_status, payment.payment_no, COALESCE(payment.status, 'NOT_CREATED') AS payment_status, payment.channel, payment.amount, payment.paid_at, payment.created_at FROM ticket_order orders LEFT JOIN payment_record payment ON payment.id = ( SELECT MAX(latest.id) FROM payment_record latest WHERE latest.order_id = orders.id ) WHERE orders.id = #{orderId} AND orders.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_item item JOIN ticket_order orders ON orders.id = item.order_id JOIN train_run run ON run.id = item.run_id JOIN train_stop from_stop ON from_stop.train_id = run.train_id AND from_stop.stop_seq = item.from_seq JOIN train_stop to_stop ON to_stop.train_id = run.train_id AND to_stop.stop_seq = item.to_seq WHERE orders.user_id = #{userId} AND item.passenger_id = #{passengerId} AND orders.status IN ('PENDING_PAYMENT', 'PAID') AND (orders.status <> 'PENDING_PAYMENT' OR orders.expire_at > NOW()) AND item.status IN ('LOCKED', 'ISSUED') AND #{departureDateTime} < TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(run.run_date, INTERVAL to_stop.arrival_day_offset DAY), to_stop.arrival_time) AND #{arrivalDateTime} > TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(run.run_date, INTERVAL from_stop.departure_day_offset DAY), from_stop.departure_time)
SELECT id FROM ticket_order WHERE status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND expire_at <= NOW() ORDER BY expire_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE order_item SET status = 'CANCELLED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'LOCKED'
